about: This ruleset enforces the rules of the App Defense Alliance's Cloud Profile, version 1.0.  See <https://github.com/appdefensealliance/ASA-WG/blob/main/Cloud%20App%20and%20Config%20Profile/Cloud%20App%20and%20Config%20Specification.md> for details.

awslambda-runtime-deprecated.json.comment: ADA-CP 1.2.1 Ensure that all AWS Lambda functions are configured to use a current (not deprecated) runtime

iam-no-support-role.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.2.1 Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support

account-security-contact-details-missing.comment: ADA-CP 2.3.2 Ensure security contact information is registered

iam-root-account-with-access-keys.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.7.1 Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists

iam-user-password-key-assigned-at-creati.comment: ADA-CP 2.7.2 Do not setup access keys during initial user setup for all IAM users that have a console password

iam-admin-policy-attached.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.7.3 Ensure IAM policies that allow full ':' administrative privileges are not attached

iam-password-policy-minimum-length.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.8.2 Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater

iam-user-with-multiple-access-keys.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.8.3 Ensure there is only one active access key available for any single IAM user

iam-user-no-key-rotation.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.8.4 Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less

iam-password-policy-reuse-enabled.json.comment: ADA-CP 2.9.1 Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse

iam-unused-credentials-not-disabled-or-r.comment: ADA-CP 2.10.1 Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled

iam-root-credentials-used-recently.json.comment: ADA-CP 1.11.1 Eliminate use of the 'root' user for administrative and daily tasks
